question: How is Christ different from the earthly priests, according to Hebrews 10:11-12?
options: The priests stand and offer sacrifices again and again, but Christ offered one sacrifice and sat down
The priests sat down, but Christ stands every day
The priests offered one sacrifice, but Christ offers many
The priests served in heaven, but Christ served on earth
explanation: Hebrews 10:11-12 says every priest stands and offers the same sacrifices again and again, but Christ offered for all time one sacrifice for sins and sat down at the right hand of God.
